notes: This reference separates embedded Catch2 evidence from portable public-API C++ TCK evidence; neither establishes conformance. The embedded Catch2 case verifies successful explicit-MIM Create using the official 2025 MIM file. The portable TCK scenario verifies the supplied-standard-MIM and no-MIM automatic-standard-MIM paths, plus rejection of the reserved HLAstandardMIM designator. Arbitrary custom-MIM contents, the MIM-before-FOM ordering child, remote-provider interoperability, protected review, and conformance remain open.

tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_explicit_mim_create_catch2.cpp::Embedded Create Federation Execution accepts a validated explicit MIM path

requirements.scope: The public C++ TCK uses the adapter-supplied official 2025 MIM with Create Federation Execution With MIM, and separately omits the MIM argument and verifies a standard MOM class/attribute. It does not establish arbitrary custom-MIM contents or MIM-before-FOM ordering.
The public Create Federation Execution With MIM call supplies the reserved HLAstandardMIM designator and asserts DesignatorIsHLAstandardMIM.
